_README: Cowork→Orchestrator backlog. Staged via: python3 runner/cowork_stage.py --commit. Contract-first per project (first task = contracts-*, deps []). Prompts are self-contained with explicit file scope + an acceptance test, per planner.py. The runner builds each in an isolated {repo}-wt/{slug} worktree, gated by cost caps + kill switch + tests + approval cards. Nothing spends until the runner is unpaused per ACTIVATION.md.

tasks.prompt: CONTRACT TASK (boundary-pinning; no feature code). Create shared/contracts/ with TypeScript interface files that every downstream task imports so parallel branches cannot disagree on boundaries: (1) decisionBudget.ts surface-id registry + the Outcome/One-knob/Proof wrapper props contract (build on the existing server/utils/ux/decisionBudget.ts); (2) xappSignal.ts — the cross-app operational-risk-signal payload {ts, eventType, severity, orgId, affectedEntity, metadata} consumed at server/api/apparently/*/signal and emitted by Apparently; (3) warRoomSync.ts — the Tomorrow<->Smarter war-room push/pull contract matching smarter/server/api/warroom/bridge.post.ts (WarRoomUpdate, WarRoomBridgeEvent); (4) perpLifecycle.ts — the drift->propose->re-strike->re-price->re-prove event contract; (5) contingentIdentity.ts — the default-OFF anonymity feature-flag + contingent-reveal state machine types. Acceptance: `npm run typecheck` passes; a unit test asserts each interface is exported and stable. Do NOT implement behavior here.

Generalize the 5/95 doctrine wrapper. Add components/ui/FiveNinetyFive.vue implementing Outcome (95% shown as fact) / One-knob (single Recommended override) / disclosure (everything else) / mandatory GlassBox proof, per shared/contracts/decisionBudget.ts. Wire server/utils/ux/decisionBudget.ts to the EXISTING telemetry (server/utils/ux/magicMomentTracker.ts, uxExperimentRunner.ts) so measured interactions per surface are flagged when they exceed budget. Fix the two declared violations: pages/app/onboarding/institution.vue (6->3) and the war-room surface (8->5) by collapsing advanced controls behind disclosure. Make scripts/lint-decision-budgets.mjs BLOCKING for declared surfaces (flip the footer to process.exit). Acceptance: `node scripts/lint-decision-budgets.mjs` reports 0 declared-surface violations; `npx vitest run server/utils/ux/__tests__/decisionBudget.test.ts` green.

pages/app/mandate.vue currently renders ~105 discretionary controls (worst 5/95 violation in the repo). Replace it with a regret-minimizing inferred mandate: pre-fill ALL fields from peer-consensus (server/utils/autonomy/constitutionCompiler.ts) + the institution's own public-data history, present ONE confirm decision ('looks right / adjust'), and move the full field set behind a 'More controls' disclosure. Preserve the existing mandatePolicy round-trip (server/utils/hive/mandatePolicy.ts) — no field is lost, just defaulted+hidden. Acceptance: `node scripts/lint-decision-budgets.mjs --all` shows app/mandate within a declared budget of 3; existing mandate API tests still pass.

Implement the self-shrinking Trust Ratchet generalizing server/utils/hive/approvalQueue.ts learning-mode: any decision a user has ratified N times graduates to autonomous; each surface recomputes its presented decisions to the user's current trust frontier so 5/95 -> 2/98 -> 1/99 over time. Pure core in server/utils/ux/trustRatchet.ts + tests. Acceptance: `npx vitest run server/utils/ux/__tests__/trustRatchet.test.ts` proves graduation after N approvals and per-user frontier recompute.

Close the perpetual lifecycle loop per shared/contracts/perpLifecycle.ts. Add a cron handler (server/api/cron/perp-lifecycle.post.ts + server/utils/otc/eventOptions/lifecycleManager.ts) that: reads open perpetual positions, computes Greeks drift via mmHedgeOrchestrator.detectNakedInventory, calls proposeHedge, applies perpetualLegs.reStrikePerpetualLeg, re-prices, and mints a fresh C1 proof — honoring the distanceToResolution<5% resolution-zone guard (no auto re-strike inside the zone; escalate instead). Acceptance: `npx vitest run` of a new lifecycleManager.test.ts simulating a drift event drives end-to-end re-strike+re-price+proof, and asserts the guard blocks re-strike inside the resolution zone.

Build the Composite Payoff Compiler over the existing server/utils/otc/payoffDSL.ts. Input: a risk spec (NL or risk-vector). Output: an allowlist-valid instrument (gradient ramp / call-spread-on-leg / reinstatement) chosen via composeProgram + assertComposable, with perpetual-vs-discrete auto-choice by comparing funding carry to one-off cost over the exposure horizon, fail-closed against instrumentAllowlist + a structural backtest. File: server/utils/otc/compositePayoffCompiler.ts. Acceptance: a test feeds a risk spec and asserts the returned instrument passes the allowlist+backtest, picks discrete for a one-off exposure with a stated cost delta, and rejects an un-backtested composite.

Add a cross-book funding equilibrium engine (server/utils/otc/fundingEquilibrium.ts): given the netted system state across all open perpetual positions, set funding rates that clear aggregate risk so each user's re-strike references the network state (marginal hedge cost falls as the book grows). Pure + tested. Acceptance: a test shows that adding offsetting demand lowers the computed marginal funding cost, conserving the per-position guards.

Wire generatorV3 + payoffDSL + the backtest gate into an autonomous instrument-discovery loop (server/utils/otc/instrumentDiscovery.ts): every autonomously-generated underlying spawns its perpetual-hedge, embedded-option, and gradient-payout variants; backtest each; promote Pareto-winners into the catalog; fail-closed on un-backtested composites. Acceptance: a test asserts a new underlying yields backtested variants and that a failing variant is never promoted.

Add the war-room auto-skip gate + learning frontier. Route clauses where novelty<30 && risk<30 && notional<cap && commonlyApprovedByThisUser to the existing email/1-button path (server/utils/coordination/approvalNotify.ts + /api/approvals/inline/[token]) instead of opening a room, using server/utils/warRoom/noveltySentinel.ts scores. Wire the stubbed hivemind learning-mode into a per-user, per-clause-type auto-approve frontier that expands on each approve/reject, plus a counsel-needed signal. Files: server/utils/warRoom/autoSkipGate.ts + learningFrontier.ts. Acceptance: tests prove a gated clause skips the room, a clause failing any condition opens it, and the frontier widens after repeated approvals.

Apply 5/95 to counsel. In the war-room UI badge 95% of clauses '✓ at-market, auto-accepted' (market-standard percentile) so only out-of-market clauses are action items; pre-compute each open clause's ZOPA + a proposed market-median midpoint; generate a pre-call briefing pack; and add a post-counsel one-button close that fires the existing closingWorkflow + docusign.ts. Acceptance: a test on a sample deal surfaces only out-of-market clauses, attaches a ZOPA midpoint to each, and the one-button close advances the closing workflow to send_for_signature.

Implement the hierarchical mesh-of-rings netting topology (server/utils/otc/rings/meshOfRings.ts) that composes many small-N rings (capacityFormation/multilateralNetting/selfHealingRing) into a mesh giving 100s-1000s-party risk dispersion WITHOUT a single large ring — preserving the N6 non-CCP / bilateral posture. Emit a breach-resilience metric (max single-party default impact as % of each party's net). Acceptance: a 1000-party simulation disperses risk, the breach-resilience metric is <1% per party, and the existing posture invariants (failingInvariants) still hold.

Upgrade credit from soft-rank to hard, market-priced gate in server/utils/otc/rings/creditReliability.ts + creditStore.ts: user-set AND Tomorrow-set minimum-tier admission; a debt-ceiling absorbing penalty state so serial defaulters cannot fully recover reputation (portable in the credit passport); risk-priced participation (wider spread from predictDeterioration severity); and a hedgeable credit passport (a perp on a counterparty's passport). Acceptance: tests show a sub-tier party is denied or priced wider, and a serial defaulter's reputation recovery is capped.

Wire three-pronged instant breach remediation in server/utils/otc/rings/defaultManagement.ts: on breach (1) auto-fire selfHealingRing + discoverPairings to source a replacement party/parcels so honest parties' contract resumes immediately, (2) open a pre-agreed shared-cost remediation matter via the Smarter bridge (warRoomSync contract), (3) apply the credit penalty on reveal. Acceptance: a simulated breach triggers replacement sourcing + a remediation matter payload + a credit penalty + contract resume, all in one flow, with tests.

Add per-contract (not per-bucket) hedge derivation: extract each loan/policy/customer-contract risk vector via the existing extraction layer (server/utils/extraction/verticalExtractors.ts, documentProcessor.ts) and derive a specific hedge bound to that contract id. File: server/utils/otc/perContractHedger.ts. Acceptance: a test ingests a small loan tape and asserts one hedge per contract with extraction provenance, measurably tighter than the bucket baseline.

Make hedges follow the contract lifecycle. Consume Apparently loan-state signals (shared/contracts/xappSignal.ts; default/prepay/cancel/paid/degrade) at server/api/apparently/bank/exposure-sync and adjust the per-contract hedge via perpetualLegs.reStrikePerpetualLeg in real time (stop on removal, increase on degrade). Acceptance: a test simulates a default (hedge stops) and a degradation (hedge increases), each with a fresh proof.

Build the cross-portfolio proprietary risk score (server/utils/risk/underwritingScore.ts) trained on loan/policy outcomes across all users (by firm/geo/segment/global, building on selfImprovingEngine), then expose origination-embedded hedge quoting: at underwriting, return 'we can hedge residual to X for Y bps' via the Apparently bank bridge, plus a peer benchmark percentile. Acceptance: a test returns score + hedge-to-X + bps price + percentile for a candidate loan and backtests the recommendation against realized outcomes.

Extend server/utils/hive/hedgeAttributionEngine.ts to compute+display the full benefit cascade with proof: capital freed ('$X available for lending'), earnings-volatility reduced (%), earnings uplift from risk-free premium (%), and event-time avoided-loss receipts ('you just avoided $X'); add an emergent-benefit discovery pass that mines each org's own data for second-order gains; and regenerate the compliance doc set (SRT/ASC 815/RBC/constitution, each chained to its C1 proof) on every re-optimization so the regulatory posture is never stale. Acceptance: a test simulates a market event and asserts a defensible avoided-$ receipt with a proof trail, and that a re-optimization regenerates the chained compliance docs.

Invert onboarding into outbound demand. Pre-compute the OnboardingPackage (server/utils/autonomy/instantInstitution.ts) for entities already ingested (FDIC list) and mint personalized 'click-to-arm' URLs showing trapped $ + drafted constitution + first hedges; add a shadow-mode pre-commitment receipt that backtests the autonomous book against their real public positions for 60-90 days. Acceptance: a test turns one identifier into a full value surface + a shadow-backtest receipt with no further input.

Expand the contingent-ECP-identity legal document set under legal/ (the rider + comparables memo are already drafted by Cowork). Produce: (a) ISDA Schedule/Confirmation integration language enabling contingent identity escrow + reveal-on-trigger; (b) the IOI anonymity disclosure schedule; (c) an Identity Custodian / escrow-agent agreement template; (d) the unanimously-pre-agreed breach-remediation engagement-letter template; (e) finalize the comparables validity memo. ALL marked DRAFT — FOR EXECUTION BY COUNSEL, default-OFF feature, ECP-only. Acceptance: docs exist under legal/, cross-reference shared/contracts/contingentIdentity.ts, and each carries the DRAFT/counsel-execution header.

CONTRACT TASK. Add a vitest harness to Smarter (currently no test runner): install vitest, add 'test' script, create tests/ with one smoke test. Pin types/integration.ts mirroring Tomorrow's shared/contracts/warRoomSync.ts and xappSignal.ts so the Smarter side of the bridge cannot drift. Acceptance: `npm test` runs and the smoke test + a contract-shape test pass.

Complete the live path of server/api/warroom/bridge.post.ts against the pinned warRoomSync contract: real push/pull using TOMORROW_WARROOM_API_URL/KEY, set ProjectItem.tomorrowConnected on connect, and add the pre-agreed remediation-firm matter hook that Tomorrow's breach-remediation calls. Acceptance: a test round-trips push+pull against a contract mock and asserts a remediation matter is created from a breach payload.

Emit operational risk signals to Tomorrow from server/utils/standing.ts + reliabilityScore.ts + the IssueAgent: when a matter/relationship degrades, POST an xappSignal (degrading relationship, missed response, stalled negotiation) to Tomorrow so its risk scorer can hedge the growing risk. Respect the information barrier (no client PII). Acceptance: a test asserts a degradation event produces a well-formed signal excluding PII.

Centralize the hardcoded MODELS map in server/utils/llm.ts into server/utils/model-policy.ts (mirror Apparently's selectModel(taskType)); replace all literal model strings with the policy lookup. Acceptance: a test asserts no literal 'claude-*' model strings remain outside model-policy.ts and selectModel returns the right tier per task.

Apply the 5/95 doctrine to Smarter surfaces, reusing its existing trust dial (counsel_only/co_pilot/auto_pilot in server/utils/governance.ts) as the autonomy substrate. Port a decision-budget lint for Smarter's pages (war room, matter detail, now/approve) and collapse advanced controls behind disclosure so attorneys see only the 5% that matters. Acceptance: a budget lint script reports the war-room and matter surfaces within budget.

CONTRACT + PUBLISHER TASK. Extend Smarter's Apparently integration to publish capability feeds beyond workstreams. (1) Add types/apparently-capabilities.ts defining the cross-app capability contracts — all carry opaque IDs only, no PII: MatterFeedEntry (matter_id, status, matter_type, risk_level, regulatory_flags, updated_at — NO client name/content), FilingFeedEntry (filing_id, filing_type, jurisdiction, status, due_date, accountable_role — NO filer identity), GovernanceFeedEntry (workspace_id, trust_tier, streak_count, last_override_at, autonomous_action_count), CadeFeedEntry (finding_id, document_type, disposition, severity, materiality_score — NO document content), ConflictFeedEntry (conflict_id, matter_ids, severity, resolution_status — NO party names). (2) Create server/utils/apparentlyCapabilityPublisher.ts with HMAC-signed POST (reuse apparentlyWorkstreamBridge.ts pattern) and per-capability publish functions: publishMatterFeed, publishFilingFeed, publishGovernanceFeed, publishCadeFeed, publishConflictFeed. Each strips PII before egress. (3) Add API routes api/integrations/apparently-matters.post.ts, apparently-filings.post.ts, apparently-governance.post.ts, apparently-cade.post.ts, apparently-conflicts.post.ts — each calls the publisher on relevant state changes. (4) Pin contract shapes with vitest tests asserting no PII fields leak. Acceptance: `npm test` passes including 5 new contract-shape tests; each publisher function returns a well-formed HMAC-signed payload with zero PII fields.

Wire Smarter's Legal Event Protocol (server/utils/legalEventProtocol.ts) to publish events to Apparently. Add server/utils/legalEventApparentlyBridge.ts that: (1) subscribes to the local append-only event store for new legal events, (2) filters to events with cross-platform relevance (regulatory_filing, compliance_determination, obligation_breach, credential_verification), (3) HMAC-signs and POSTs to APPARENTLY_LEGAL_EVENT_URL, (4) records delivery receipts. Use the existing Ed25519-signed event structure as the payload — Apparently verifies the signature independently. Add api/integrations/apparently-legal-events.post.ts as the trigger endpoint. Acceptance: a test asserts a regulatory_filing event produces a signed delivery to the bridge with a receipt; irrelevant event types are filtered out.

CONTRACT TASK. Pin shared/contracts/tomorrow-signal.ts (mirror Tomorrow's xappSignal + the existing rewards/gaming S2S) and an outbox handler interface for operational-risk signals. Add the fixed-vector HMAC contract test alongside tests/engines/rewards-s2s-contract.test.ts. Acceptance: `npm test` passes including the new signal-signing fixed-vector test.

Build server/utils/tomorrow-client.ts: an HMAC-SHA256 signer (reusing rewards/s2s.ts patterns) that POSTs operational-risk signals to Tomorrow's /api/apparently/{bank,fabric,gaming,risk-studio}/signal endpoints, plus a server/engines/outbox/handlers/operational-risk-handler.ts with retry/dead-letter. Enforce the information barrier (allowlist fields only; no participant PII / contract terms / internal pricing). Acceptance: a contract test round-trips a signed signal and asserts non-allowlisted fields are stripped before egress.

Wire the four detection engines to emit via the outbox operational-risk handler: licensing/renewal-engine.ts (critical <30d), regulator-intel/portal-monitor.ts (filing.status_change), disclosure/burden-estimator.ts (filing-burden delta), email-triage/triage-engine.ts (high-risk inbound). Each emits an xappSignal to Tomorrow on its existing trigger. Acceptance: a test per engine asserts a signal is emitted on the trigger and is information-barrier clean.

CONTRACT TASK (boundary-pinning for Vigil absorption engines). Vigil has been merged into Apparently - all Vigil capabilities live under server/engines/vigil/. Create server/engines/vigil/contracts/ with TypeScript interface files that every downstream Vigil engine task imports: (1) alpl-types.ts - AlplSourceApp (apparently|illuminati|smarter|trojun|orchestrator - NO 'vigil' as separate app), AlplEventKind (10 kinds), AlplEventEnvelope, AlplPropagationMeta, AlplConsent (revocable: true), AlplSubscription, AlplProcessingReceipt, AlplFeedbackSignal. (2) agent-bot-types.ts - OfficialIdentity, BehavioralSignal (4-axis sentiment: enforcement/innovation/consumer/bipartisan on [-1,1]), OfficialBehavioralProfile, OfficialReactionPrediction (limitation disclaimer required), ScraperSourceConfig (respectRobotsTxt: true), IngestionReceipt (publicDataOnly: true). (3) simulation-types.ts - ProductSpec, SimulationConfig, SimulationScenario, AgentSimulationRound, SimulationSynthesis (humanReviewRequired: true, automaticRegulatoryConclusion: false). (4) integration-types.ts - external-only adapters for Illuminati (IntelligenceGraph, RegulatoryRadar), Smarter (ContextualAnalysis, PredictionCalibration), Orchestrator (ModuleEnhancement, FleetCoordination). Also extend server/engines/coordination/types.ts CoordinationEventType union with 'alpl.authority_update' through 'alpl.integration_health' (10 new dotted types). Acceptance: scoped tsc passes; a test asserts each interface is exported and AlplSourceApp does NOT include 'vigil'.

Implement the ALPL engine under server/engines/vigil/alpl/engine.ts. Pure functions, no I/O beyond returned values. Functions: (1) emitAlplEvent - validate consent (granted, not expired, scopes present), payload kind matches envelope, evidence present, no self-targeting, generate eventId + dedup key (SHA-256 of kind+workspace+payload) + idempotency token. sourceApp defaults to 'apparently'. (2) routeAlplEvent - filter by TTL, hop limit, consent expiry, subscription matching. (3) processAlplEvent - idempotency via dedup key; consequential kinds (authority_update, model_candidate, calibration_drift) + critical priority -> queued_for_review with humanApprovalRequired: true. (4) recordAlplFeedback - with digest. (5) runAlplLearningCycle - analyze feedback, suggest improvements; autoAppliedChanges: 0 ALWAYS, humanApproval: true ALWAYS. Wire into server/engines/coordination/event-publisher.ts for internal routing (emit coordination events for each ALPL event kind). Add server/engines/vigil/alpl/external-publisher.ts using the outbox pattern (server/engines/outbox/) for HTTP delivery to Illuminati/Smarter/Orchestrator with HMAC signing. Acceptance: a demo function validates all invariants; coordination events fire for internal ALPL events; scoped tsc passes.

Implement agent-bot digital twins under server/engines/vigil/agent-bots/engine.ts. Pure functions using createHash from node:crypto. Functions: (1) validateScraperSource - robots.txt compliance, rate <=30/min. (2) ingestBehavioralSignal - validate officialId, public source URL+citation, topics, sentiment ranges [-1,1], position confidences [0,100]; return BehavioralSignal with sourceDigest. (3) compileBehavioralProfile - aggregate sentiment, topic expertise with trend detection (hardening/softening/stable based on recent vs overall avg), enforcement history, voting patterns; profileDigest. (4) predictOfficialReaction - composite from innovation(35%), enforcement(25%), consumer x risk(20%), precedents; map to supportive/cautious/opposed/hostile; ALWAYS include limitation 'not a determination of the official's private views'. (5) buildSimulationConfig - system prompt template with CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS disclaimer. Connect to data/vigil/official-sources/catalog.ts as citation spine. Wire bidirectional with server/engines/regulator-intel/: portal-monitor detections -> behavioral signals; profiles -> jurisdiction profile enrichment. GATE: profiles model real named public officials - publicDataOnly/robots.txt/rate-limit/human-review guardrails are load-bearing, and counsel sign-off is required before any profile surfaces in product. Acceptance: demo function passes all invariants; publicDataOnly: true on all receipts; scoped tsc passes.

Implement pre-launch regulatory simulation under server/engines/vigil/simulation/engine.ts. Pure functions. (1) validateProductSpec - required fields, feature risk domains. (2) createSimulationConfig - generate 3 default scenarios (baseline, heightened scrutiny, risk-mitigated), validate spec + officials. (3) runAgentSimulationRound - one official against one scenario; call predictOfficialReaction from agent-bots; generate specific objections per feature/domain, requested conditions, engagement recommendations. (4) synthesizeSimulation - aggregate all rounds; per-official worst reaction, aggregate objections by domain, engagement sequence (hostile/opposed first), structural recommendations for blocking/material features, scenario comparison. ALWAYS: humanReviewRequired: true, automaticRegulatoryConclusion: false. Wire to engines/vigil/exam-coverage.ts for coverage-aware scenario generation. Acceptance: full pipeline runs; governance invariants hold; scoped tsc passes.

Implement external-only integration adapters under server/engines/vigil/integrations/engine.ts. NO self-integration (Vigil is inside Apparently - what was previously Apparently integration is now internal engine calls). External adapters only: Illuminati (pushIntelligenceGraph, pushRegulatoryRadar), Smarter (enrichSmarterAnalysis, calibrateSmarterPredictions), Orchestrator (enhanceOrchestratorModule, coordinateFleetUpdate). Each validates consent (granted, not expired), returns request with digest, never includes raw workspace data. Shared secrets from env: APPARENTLY_ILLUMINATI_SECRET, APPARENTLY_SMARTER_SECRET, APPARENTLY_ORCHESTRATOR_SECRET. Health check + audit entry functions. Use outbox handler pattern for retry/dead-letter. Acceptance: contract test round-trips each adapter; no IntegrationRequest where sourceApp='vigil' or targetApp='apparently'; scoped tsc passes.

Create Nuxt/Nitro API routes under server/api/vigil/: (1) alpl/emit.post.ts - call emitAlplEvent, internal coordination + external propagation. (2) alpl/feedback.post.ts - recordAlplFeedback. (3) alpl/learning-cycle.post.ts - runAlplLearningCycle. (4) agent-bots/ingest.post.ts - ingestBehavioralSignal + createIngestionReceipt. (5) agent-bots/profile.post.ts - compileBehavioralProfile. (6) agent-bots/predict.post.ts - predictOfficialReaction. (7) simulation/run.post.ts - full pipeline: config -> rounds loop -> synthesis. (8) integrations/health.get.ts - check all external app connections. Each handler: try/catch wrapping, {status, ...result} return, createError on validation failure, Zod-validated bodies, authorize via requireOrgMembership. Add TODO comment for S2S auth middleware. Acceptance: each route compiles; npm run build confirms every route registered under .output/server/chunks/routes/api/vigil/; scoped tsc passes.

Create Supabase migration for Vigil tables in Apparently's project. DO NOT APPLY TO PROD WITHOUT PIPER'S EXPLICIT APPROVAL - author the migration, apply to a Supabase branch first. All tables prefixed vigil_ to namespace: vigil_alpl_events (event_id UNIQUE, kind, source_app, payload JSONB, propagation JSONB, consent JSONB, receipt_digest), vigil_alpl_subscriptions, vigil_alpl_processing_receipts (FK to events), vigil_alpl_feedback, vigil_official_identities (official_id UNIQUE), vigil_behavioral_signals (FK to identities, source_type, sentiment JSONB), vigil_official_profiles (FK to identities, profile JSONB, cached), vigil_simulation_runs (simulation_id UNIQUE, workspace_id, spec/config/synthesis JSONB), vigil_simulation_rounds (FK to runs), vigil_integration_audit (source_app, target_app, status, latency). Indexes on kind, source_app, official_id, source_type. Enable RLS on all tables with workspace-scoped policies matching Apparently's existing pattern. Acceptance: migration applies cleanly on a branch; RLS policies active.

Register all new Vigil engines, API routes, and tables as VigilSurface entries in the absorption inventory (server/engines/vigil/absorption-plan.ts). Each new file gets a surface entry with appropriate kind (api/contract/table), regulated flag (true for anything touching official identities, behavioral signals, simulations), state 'contract_extracted'. Run measureParity() and canRetireBrand() to produce an updated parity report. Do NOT mark anything as 'absorbed' until verification is complete. Acceptance: all new surfaces are inventoried; measureParity() counts accurately; no silentlyDropped entries.

Port Illuminati's CADE scoring pipeline into Apparently. tasks._comment: === SMARTER CAPABILITY BRIDGE (dual-mode — Smarter stays standalone) ===
tasks.prompt: CONTRACT TASK (boundary-pinning for Smarter capability bridges in Apparently). Smarter stays standalone — this is NOT a full absorption. These contracts define read-only capability views that Apparently imports from Smarter via HMAC-signed bridges. Create shared/contracts/smarter-*.ts files: (1) smarter-matter-feed.ts — MatterFeedEntry (matter_id: string, status: string, matter_type: string, risk_level: 'low'|'medium'|'high'|'critical', regulatory_flags: string[], updated_at: string — NO client name, NO document content, NO party identifiers), MatterFeedBatch, MatterFeedImportResult. Zod schema for runtime validation. (2) smarter-filing-feed.ts — FilingFeedEntry (filing_id, filing_type, jurisdiction, status: 'pending'|'submitted'|'accepted'|'rejected'|'overdue', due_date, accountable_role — NO filer identity, NO filing content), FilingFeedBatch. Zod schema. (3) smarter-governance-feed.ts — GovernanceFeedEntry (workspace_id, trust_tier: 'counsel_only'|'co_pilot'|'auto_pilot', streak_count, last_override_at, autonomous_action_count_24h), GovernanceSyncResult. Zod schema. (4) smarter-cade-feed.ts — CadeFeedEntry (finding_id, document_type, disposition: 'FLAG-FOR-HUMAN'|'DRAFT-FACT-REQUEST'|'AUTO-FIX', severity, materiality_score — NO document content, NO client ref), CadeFeedBatch. Zod schema. (5) smarter-conflict-feed.ts — ConflictFeedEntry (conflict_id, matter_ids: string[], severity, resolution_status — NO party names), ConflictFeedBatch. Zod schema. (6) smarter-legal-events.ts — LegalEventEnvelope (event_id, event_type: 'regulatory_filing'|'compliance_determination'|'obligation_breach'|'credential_verification', ed25519_signature, payload — already Ed25519-signed by Smarter, Apparently verifies independently), LegalEventBatch. Pin each contract with a Zod schema AND a vitest shape test asserting: all PII-carrying field names are absent, required opaque-ID fields are present, Zod parse succeeds on a fixture. Acceptance: `npm test` passes including 6 new contract-shape tests; no contract type contains fields for names, emails, addresses, document_content, or client_name.

Build the matter awareness bridge. Create server/engines/smarter-matter-import.ts following the smarter-workstream-import.ts pattern: (1) normalize incoming MatterFeedBatch via the Zod schema from shared/contracts/smarter-matter-feed.ts, (2) compute content digest per entry (SHA-256 of canonical JSON), (3) upsert into smarter_matter_feed table (matter_id UNIQUE per workspace, digest for idempotency), (4) return ImportResult with imported/updated/idempotent/stale counts. Create server/api/smarter/matters/import.post.ts with HMAC validation (reuse S2S signing pattern from tomorrow-client.ts). Create Supabase migration for smarter_matter_feed table (workspace_id, matter_id, status, matter_type, risk_level, regulatory_flags JSONB, digest, imported_at, updated_at) with RLS. Acceptance: a test round-trips a MatterFeedBatch through import; duplicate batch returns idempotent; HMAC mismatch is rejected; migration applies on branch.

Build the filing status bridge. Create server/engines/smarter-filing-import.ts following the smarter-workstream-import.ts pattern: normalize FilingFeedBatch, digest-based idempotent upsert into smarter_filing_feed table. Wire into Apparently's existing regulatory filing system (shared/contracts/filings-as-code.ts) so Smarter filings appear alongside Apparently-native filings in the regulatory calendar. Create server/api/smarter/filings/import.post.ts with HMAC validation. Add smarter_filing_feed table to the migration (workspace_id, filing_id UNIQUE, filing_type, jurisdiction, status, due_date, accountable_role, digest, imported_at). Acceptance: a test imports a FilingFeedBatch; imported filings appear in filingSchedule() alongside native filings; HMAC mismatch rejected.

Build governance harmonization. Create server/engines/smarter-governance-sync.ts: (1) receive GovernanceFeedEntry from Smarter, (2) store in smarter_governance_state table (workspace_id UNIQUE, trust_tier, streak_count, last_override_at, autonomous_action_count_24h, synced_at), (3) expose getSmartGovernancePosture(workspaceId) for Apparently's governance gates to query. The sync is READ-ONLY from Apparently's perspective — Smarter is authoritative on its own trust dial. Apparently uses this to adjust its own gates: if Smarter's trust tier is counsel_only, Apparently should not auto-process Smarter-originated data without human review. Create server/api/smarter/governance/sync.post.ts with HMAC validation. Acceptance: sync stores posture; getSmarterGovernancePosture returns current tier; counsel_only tier triggers review flag on Smarter-originated imports.

Build the CADE triage bridge. Create server/engines/smarter-cade-import.ts: normalize CadeFeedBatch, digest-based idempotent upsert into smarter_cade_findings table. This gives Apparently visibility into Smarter's document triage results — useful for regulatory awareness (e.g., a CADE finding of type 'FLAG-FOR-HUMAN' with severity 'critical' on a regulatory document should surface in Apparently's regulatory dashboard). Create server/api/smarter/cade/import.post.ts with HMAC validation. Add smarter_cade_findings table (workspace_id, finding_id UNIQUE, document_type, disposition, severity, materiality_score, digest, imported_at). Wire critical findings (severity='critical' AND disposition='FLAG-FOR-HUMAN') into Apparently's coordination event publisher as 'smarter.cade_critical_finding' events. Acceptance: a test imports a CadeFeedBatch; critical findings emit coordination events; non-critical findings import silently; HMAC mismatch rejected.

Build the conflict awareness bridge. Create server/engines/smarter-conflict-import.ts: normalize ConflictFeedBatch, digest-based upsert into smarter_conflict_signals table. Conflicts from Smarter should surface in Apparently's compliance dashboard because a conflict of interest in legal matters may have regulatory implications. Create server/api/smarter/conflicts/import.post.ts with HMAC validation. Add smarter_conflict_signals table (workspace_id, conflict_id UNIQUE, matter_ids JSONB, severity, resolution_status, digest, imported_at). Wire unresolved conflicts (resolution_status != 'resolved') into coordination events as 'smarter.conflict_unresolved'. Acceptance: a test imports a ConflictFeedBatch; unresolved conflicts emit events; resolved conflicts import without events; HMAC rejected on mismatch.

Build the legal event protocol consumer. Create server/engines/smarter-legal-event-import.ts: (1) receive LegalEventBatch from Smarter, (2) verify each event's Ed25519 signature independently (Smarter's public key from env SMARTER_LEGAL_EVENT_PUBLIC_KEY), (3) reject events with invalid signatures (do NOT import unsigned/mis-signed events), (4) store verified events in smarter_legal_events table (event_id UNIQUE, event_type, payload JSONB, signature, verified_at), (5) route events to coordination event publisher by type: regulatory_filing -> 'smarter.regulatory_filing', compliance_determination -> 'smarter.compliance_determination', obligation_breach -> 'smarter.obligation_breach', credential_verification -> 'smarter.credential_verification'. Create server/api/smarter/legal-events/import.post.ts with HMAC validation (transport-level) + Ed25519 verification (event-level — double signature). Add smarter_legal_events table. Also extend server/engines/coordination/types.ts CoordinationEventType union with 'smarter.regulatory_filing', 'smarter.compliance_determination', 'smarter.obligation_breach', 'smarter.credential_verification'. Acceptance: valid-signature events import and emit coordination events; invalid-signature events are rejected with error; both HMAC and Ed25519 must pass; new event types are in CoordinationEventType.
